a.text: I was born by the River.
Dad told me that the River links the entire world. Build a good boat, and you can go anywhere.
Dad hated the snow. People can't go out when it snows, so 'business' stops and the whole family starves. That's how I got my name.

I didn't know what 'business' was, only that Dad would come home at the end of each month with a sword in one hand and stuff for the family in the other, including a present for me. Mom would sort the stuff and wash dad's bloody clothes without a word.
Then one day, a group of people wearing armor broke into the fort. Dad lived on the River all his life, and that's where he died.
I only remember the leader. He didn't look happy at the total victory he'd just won, he only gazed at the River dyed red with blood, lost in thought.
There was only one thought on my mind.
I wanted to take revenge.
I found out where he lived. I left home, going from the easternmost edge of Yan to the westernmost.
I learned that the land was more than just the River. There were mountains, streams, forests, plains.
People lived in many different ways, and dealt with many different hardships.
The river fort was too small. Dad might have chosen a different path if he had came out and seen all the land under Heaven.
Dad was wrong. There were only so many places you could go in a boat.
Finally, I came to Yumen. He stood atop the walls with that same expression. I began to understand.
I should take revenge.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: That's about it.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Huai has the sword. The kung fu lunatic is too much for Zuo Le to deal with.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: He waited three years just to fulfill the promise... interesting man.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: How are Taihe's injuries?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: He's still unconscious.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The one who wounded Taihe was the same one who attacked Wei Yenwu. She got away in the chaos and was too fast for me to catch.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Zuo Le closed the Sword Forge. Many martial artists are... under observation.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Catastrophe lies before us, while the relationship between the military and jianghu has broken down. Yumen is only going to face even more chaos.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I could hardly reproach him for being impetuous.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You must take action yourself.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: General Zuo entrusted the garrison to me. I can't very well openly defy him.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You know I'm not just talking about what happened these few days.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You'll be leaving soon. You must answer to those who looked up to you before you leave.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Or did you think you could dodge the questions that you cannot answer clearly?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: People think that you're my student. Sometimes even I forget where you came from and treat you like I would Zuo Le and the Record Keeper.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I've never called you 'master.'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'm not your master.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You're a natural. Most of what you could do with a sword, you learned on your own. There was little I could teach you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You hid my identity from the others, allowing me to stay at Yumen.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I can't very well abandon a child to the barrens...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You never thought I would try to kill you? Or did you think I could never defeat you?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You didn't have to beat me, if you wanted revenge.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Just slip some poison into my food, or push me off the wall.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I worried that you wouldn't be able to let it go, even after killing me.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: ...I would have called you a hypocrite, if I hadn't hung around you for five years.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Five years. It's been that long?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Not so long from your point of view, is it?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Why would you say that?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Your appearance hasn't changed the slightest, and you still have that sad, depressed expression on your face, as though you've grown tired of seeing everything that happens in the world. The slowest burdenbeast would realize that you're no ordinary man.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I always thought the stories about long-lived races were a myth. Turns out there's one right next to me.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You knew.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I just never cared.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I wanted revenge. How long you could live didn't matter.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And thinking about you not being an ordinary mortal is just looking for excuses.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Like you said, climb the mountain one step at a time. All other thoughts are just distractions.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Can one truly let go of one's obsession with vengeance, one's obsession with victory and defeat, even when one's wish is fulfilled?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Distractions make your sword slow.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: We mortals need our obsessions in order to keep living... you know that.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You weren't so forceful when we first met.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You taught me a lot these five years.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Only the basics of kung fu.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: As you said, you can only teach so much, but how much one learns is up to oneself.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You should go and see those who remember you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Far too many have an obsession with you.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The big man is gone...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop right there.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You again...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If you're not in league with those criminals, why did you steal the sword? What is your connection to the man at the clinic?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't know them, and I don't know who he is.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You don't understand what kind of trouble you've gotten yourself in.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You've never lived in a nomadic city, and you know nothing about Yumen. Someone told you where the sword was and got you to steal it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But you don't understand what kind of trouble it would bring.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Tell me. Things may still be salvageable.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I told you, I'm not acting under anyone's instructions. I'm just repaying a debt.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Even if the price is your life?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Stop following me.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Whatever the truth is, I can't sit aside and let you put yourself in danger.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm trying to help you.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: All your words won't change anything. You're not a good person.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm under orders to investigate. You're the one who stole the sword. You may have your reasons, but that's no excuse for distorting the truth.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The man who arrested all the smiths at the forge can't be trusted.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They tried to cover the Shanhaizhong's escape.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: They were there to protect it!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All involved must be investigated until they are cleared of suspicion. We face the double threat of Catastrophe and criminals. I must abide by my duty to Yumen.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: My clan only makes weapons for strong and healthy Anasa who have reached the age of sixteen.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Those who receive a weapon swear to protect the young, the elderly, and the sick of the clan.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You say things about not letting me put myself in danger, about protecting a city, but you point your weapon at the common people.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is my duty...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu was right. You people think that you're always right, just because of your lofty justifications.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I slowed down on purpose, only to find that no one was following.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: You two started chatting while I still have the sword?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There's been a misunderstanding, sir. I ask that you return the sword to its rightful master.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I heard you two arguing and more or less have an idea what's going on.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: This sword belonged to the Grandmaster, but this girl sneaked it out.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I'm sure he doesn't rely on any single weapon. Don't tell me he sent you after it because he missed it so much.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to say.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Causing trouble for him would delay his retirement even more... but I promised to help this girl here.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: What a headache.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Ah-ha.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I can't really be bothered with complicated questions, but I have a quick and simple solution.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Both of you have some kung fu. Why don't you two fight it out, here and now, and whoever wins gets the sword. No weapons, hand-to-hand only.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Ridiculous! How can something so important be determined so callously?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm not fighting—

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: ...I'm in a hurry.
Fist and foot as one in points of five; catch and parry, barrage to open.
Even within an inch there lies right and wrong; focus elsewhere only negates effort.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Oh?
The day has barely begun to break. The inn's workers wipe down the tables and prepare food for the day in the kitchen.
Lee rises to the call of fowlbeast in the backyard—and the sound of fists cutting through the air.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Like father, like daughter.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Nice.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Uncle Lee...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's been a while since I've seen you practice this form. I thought maybe you had some sort of divine inspiration that helped you rise above forms and moves.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Don't tease me like that.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: The only way to get better at martial arts is to practice. There are no magical secrets.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I remember how you got on the wrong side of a gang the first time you went out on an errand for the company.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: When I arrived, all I saw was Triads lying unconscious on the ground, while you stood there like nothing had happened.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You were only sixteen...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I started learning kung fu before I learned to talk.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You remember?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: He told me...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: At least he taught you well in that regard.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Like they say, your teacher can show you the door, but you have be the one to walk through it.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Well, I suppose being shown the door is important too.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe this was the only thing that he felt he could do as a father.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not trying to defend him. He wasn't a good father, but you shouldn't let that stop you from living the life that you want.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Consider your kung fu a gift. You can always tuck it away if you don't like it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Pursuit of kung fu mastery was his path, but it doesn't have to be yours.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I have nothing against kung fu, and of course I have my own life.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I graduated magna cum laude with a degree in mechanical engineering from the Lungmen University of Science and Technology. I'm an employee of Lee's Detective Agency, and field operator for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But not the first hero of justice to graduate from LMUST.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I could be, if needed!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then tell him the next time you see him.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Uncle Lee, you...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You wouldn't just pick up a form that you haven't practiced for a long time for no reason.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Considering his irresponsible behavior all these years, it would be more than understandable if you wanted to pick a fight with him.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's okay if you lose. I doubt he was any better at your age.

a.text: Zuo Le is young for a Candleholder, but he has seen his share of cases.
However, there has never been one where he could not fight back, nor has he ever been taught what to do in such a situation.
Does he have a guilty conscience? Or just not willing to take advantage of an injured girl?
All Zuo Le does is block the attacks as they fall on him.
They both fall to the ground, their faces covered in dirt, but the girl continues to strike with all that she has.
It looks like a fight between children.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: (Shakes head and sighs)

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: The girl wins.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Catch.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Go and repay your debt, then come back and pay your medical bill.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Here's your sword, boy.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: You didn't fight back because you knew she was hurt. No shame in that.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: No need to give me that look.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: The girl promised me she'll come back. I trust her.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: If she goes back on her word, I'll catch her for you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You can go now.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Looks like you're unharmed.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Surprised? Or disappointed?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I didn't want anything to happen to you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There was a misunderstanding. Sorry to get you into trouble.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I've explained it to them. Everything is fine.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: A soldier told me that the armband, the one you gave me, was evidence retrieved from outside the city the day before.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Are you going to explain it to me or not?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Why should I, if you already know the story?
Du Yaoye's fist stops in midair. Lin Yühsia makes no motion to block or dodge.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: We've only just met. I can understand if you don't trust me.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You wanted someone to help you check out the Sword Forge, that's fine.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: But you shouldn't have used my friend as a pretext.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You don't get to apologize to me. I won't forgive you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Is this how Lungmenites do things?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's how I do things.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Well, I'm not going to come away empty-handed from this. What did you find?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Tell me everything you know.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I became certain of what I had only suspected.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Starting with the attack on the Messenger, something was off about everything we've seen.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It wasn't a coincidence that you ran into the Shanhaizhong at the Sword Forge. It's proof that Meng was in league with them.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: So it was him?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: He is the only one with both the motivation and the means to plan all this.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I don't understand why he would do it...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: What else do you know about my friend's whereabouts?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Not much. I sent someone to look into it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: In the worst case scenario, all of Yumen could be in great danger.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I hope this is not his goal, or that he has a plan...

a.text: All these years, Meng Tieyi has rarely stood outside his workshop to gaze upon it.
Inside, the yard has always felt cramped. The walls and door look more impressive when one looks on them from outside.
There are only a few days left of the month-long market. The streets are busy as ever, making the lonely Sword Forge feel conspicuous in comparison.
The 'Closed' sign has fallen to the ground, replaced by red and white sealing tape.
A rivet has fallen from the door. He has never noticed, nor has anyone told him.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Am I getting senile? I couldn't even get this one last thing done properly...
